newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen Int'l submits notes repurchase proposal.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen Int'l submits notes repurchase proposal.

text.p: Evergreen International Aviation said on Friday it has submitted a revised proposal to representatives of the holders of the company's outstanding 13.5 percent senior notes due 2002.
Under the terms of the revised proposal the company would repurchase all of the outstanding notes at 120 percent of their principal amount, the company said.
The company said it has received a commitment from a major financial institution to provide funds in the necessary amount to complete the repurchase.
In December the company had offered to buy back the notes at 110 percent of their principal amount.
